title: Clinical RAG Grounded Response
description: Schema for grounded clinical generation responses with citation enforcement.

recommendation.description: The clinical recommendation or refusal message.

evidence.description: Direct quote or paraphrase from the retrieved guideline text supporting the recommendation. Empty string allowed only when confidence is 'insufficient'.

section.description: Section or heading within the document.

page.description: Page number in the source document.

citations.description: List of citation objects. Must contain at least one entry unless confidence is 'insufficient'.

confidence.description: Confidence level of the response based on retrieved evidence quality.
